newsitem.title: USA: API says U.S. crude stocks rose in week.
newsitem.headline: API says U.S. crude stocks rose in week.

text.p: U.S. crude oil stocks held in primary storage rose 474,000 barrels in the week ended August 1 to 309.41 million barrels from 308.94 million barrels the previous week, the American Petroleum Institute said Tuesday.
API said that crude stocks excluding PADD 5 (Petroleum Administration for Defense District) fell 821,000 barrels in the week to 248.35 million barrels.
Distillate stocks rose 2.19 million barrels to 121.49 million barrels from 119.31 million barrels the prior week.
API said PADD 1 distillate stocks rose 1.74 million barrels to 48.26 million barrels.
API said gasoline production fell 100,000 barrels per day in the week to 7.78 million bpd from 7.88 million bpd in the prior week.
Gasoline stocks fell 2.71 million barrels in the week to 191.93 million barrels from 194.63 million.
Percent of stocks capacity rose to 97.1 percent from 96.1 percent the prior week.
API said reformulated gasoline stocks (RFG) rose 2.21 million barrels to 39.52 million barrels from 37.31 million barrels the previous week.
API also said refinery operating rate excluding PADD 5 rose to 102.2 percent in the week from 101.1 percent the previous week.
API said crude runs to processing units rose to 15.00 million barrels per day from 14.83 million the previous week.
Residual fuel stocks in the latest week fell to 36.33 million barrels from 36.95 million in the previous week.
Crude oil imports fell to 7.79 million barrels per day from 8.14 million, API said.
